OpenSelf is a peer-to-peer book exchange platform built with React, Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL. It allows users to list,
discover, and request book exchanges through authenticated REST APIs. 
The platform manages users, books, and exchange requests using a structured relational database. It enables efficient community-
driven sharing of educational resources through a responsive interface.
CareerLens is a high-throughput resume-to-job semantic alignment engine built on asynchronous NLP extraction and vector-space
similarity.
It optimizes candidate-job matching by leveraging in-memory skill taxonomies and transformer-based embeddings to perform real-
time gap analysis between unstructured resumes and job specifications.
Developed TrackIt, a centralized academic productivity platform featuring a dynamic assignment tracking system with status-based
monitoring, an integrated module for comprehensive note management, and a personalized dashboard for real-time progress
visualization. Built using the MERN stack, the application implements secure JWT-based authentication, and a responsive frontend
to streamline student workflow and deadline management.
